newsitem.title: USA: Merck says plans no major acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Merck says plans no major acquisitions.

text.p: Merck and Co Inc chief executive Raymond Gilmartin said on Wednesday that the company's own pipeline of new drugs was strong enough to drive the company's future growth and that Merck planned no major acquisitions.
"We would consider that to be a diversion," Gilmartin said in response to a question about the company's acquisition plans during a meeting of pharmaceutical industry analysts and investors.
Gilmartin was reiterating his previously stated position on acquisitions amid the ongoing consolidation in the global pharmaceutical industry.
